run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, SEARCH-ONLY run — same hard egress constraint as all recent runs. The session network policy denied every direct HTTPS connection to tender hosts: curl to www.tenders.gov.au returned '403 CONNECT tunnel failed' (a policy denial, not retried per proxy guidance) and WebFetch returned DNS ENOTFOUND for www.tenders.gov.au and www.business.tas.gov.au (hosts outside the session's allowed network domains). No buyer-originated portal, detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened, so discovery was limited to the WebSearch tool (US-indexed, returning mostly cached mid-2026 snapshots, JavaScript-disabled portal shells, and third-party aggregator pages). Tier 1 (AusTender, NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, WA/SA/TAS, NT QTOL, ACT) were swept via search only. Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel/TenderLink; universities/TAFEs; water/energy GBEs such as Sydney Water/Melbourne Water/Transgrid; Australia Post; public health) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery/Business Network, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside, Brisbane City Council Ariba, Endeavour Energy Ariba) were checked via search. Every corporate channel remained registration-gated or invitation-only with no publicly-visible open RFx. Three buyer-originated government/public-sector opportunities were surfaced from cached search snippets and are carried at headline level only, explicitly flagged UNVERIFIED against the primary portal. No opportunity was fabricated; leads that resolved to closed or invitation-only notices were excluded and noted in gaps.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK: all direct HTTPS to tender hosts denied by the session network policy (403 CONNECT tunnel failed / DNS ENOTFOUND — hosts outside allowed domains). To restore full discovery, at minimum these hosts must be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au (buy.nsw.gov.au), www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, and individual council/university sites (e.g. colacotway.vic.gov.au, notredame.edu.au, sunitafe.edu.au).

All three carried tenders are UNVERIFIED headline-level entries from cached search snippets; their tender_id, buyer, dates and scope could not be confirmed on the buyer-originated primary portal this run. They need a detail/verification pass once egress is restored.
No deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria extraction was possible for any opportunity — every detail page and tender document was unreachable.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, Telstra, Endeavour Energy) remained registration-gated or invitation-only; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. Recorded as portals only, consistent with prior runs.

Excluded leads (not fabricated): Maranoa Regional Council (QLD) DRFA flood-restoration tenders MRC 27016 and MRC 27015 appear to close 9 Nov 2026 — already closed as of the 11 Nov run date; MRC 27017 land sale closed 4 Nov 2026. These were excluded as closed.

WebSearch is US-indexed and returned predominantly stale or aggregator (australiantenders.com.au, projectory.com.au) data; recent (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted this run.
